channel.title: US Top News and Analysis
channel.description: CNBC is the world leader in business news and real-time financial market coverage. Find fast, actionable information.

item.title: Stocks rebound after sell-off but remain on pace for weekly decline: Live updates
item.description: The Dow ended Thursday's session down 700 points, marking its worst day since July 29.

item.title: U.S., Canada near final trade deal as Trump tariff deadline looms
item.description: Businesses have warned that Trump's new 50% duties could cripple U.S. their sales if they take effect.

item.title: U.S. military says it aided passage of 660 million barrels of oil through Strait of Hormuz since May
item.description: The security situation in Hormuz remains contested but the U.S. is helping oil get through the strait.

item.title: Why some of America's biggest brands are losing ground in China
item.description: Nike, Starbucks and GM have lost ground in China as domestic rivals, geopolitics and changing consumer preferences reshape the market.

item.title: 'A delicate dance': JD Vance says economic pressure is the best way to achieve Washington's objectives in Iran
item.description: Vance said "what has been true over the last couple of weeks is they felt a lot more pressure than we have."

item.title: JPMorgan is worried about an autumn downturn. Says AI stocks show similarities to 2000 tech peak
item.description: Stocks are headed for a weekly decline, and JPMorgan thinks there could be further downside ahead.

item.title: Gold rebounds as bond jitters, debt fears and weaker dollar revive bullion demand
item.description: Gold is rebounding as investors weigh U.S. debt concerns, a weaker dollar and stubbornly high Treasury yields.

item.title: Most Americans aren't anti-vaccine. They're uncertain — and that's a growing public health challenge
item.description: The bigger issue at hand may be that many Americans fall into a large, uncertain middle ground – neither firmly pro-vaccine nor staunchly opposed.

item.title: NATO member Romania scrambles F-16 fighter jets to destroy drone near critical European gas project
item.description: It comes weeks after Romania’s Air Force destroyed a Russian drone in its airspace.

item.title: Here are the top 10 things we're watching in the stock market Friday
item.description: Stocks are set for a higher open Friday following a nasty rate-driven pullback on Thursday

item.title: The Los Angeles Lakers sold for $12.5 billion. Here’s what every NBA team is now worth
item.description: The pending $12.5 billion Lakers sale would lift CNBC’s average NBA team valuation 21% to $6.68 billion, with the Warriors still No. 1.

item.title: 'Perfect storm' brews for global food supply this winter as grain prices soar
item.description: Fears over crop yields and farmers' ability to plant ahead of next year have come to the fore as wheat prices jump.

item.title: Wall Street's existential crisis over perpetual futures — the 24/7 security on steroids — just got urgent
item.description: Perpetual futures, or perps, are shaking up exchanges as investors seek continuous access to trading.

item.title: Bitcoin on track for 20% weekly gain as investor optimism floods back
item.description: The flagship digital currency has enjoyed a strong week boosted by several contributing factors.

item.title: Walmart just had its worst day in 4 years. JPMorgan says buy it now
item.description: Walmart shares are cheaper than usual following the stock's steep decline on Thursday after its earnings report, according to JPMorgan.

item.title: Goldman says hedge funds suffered worst underperformance vs S&P 500 in July in more than 20 years of data
item.description: Goldman says hedge funds suffered worst underperformance vs S&P 500 in July in more than 20 years of data.

item.title: U.S. bond intervention is like 'paying your mortgage with your credit card,' JPMorgan's Sullivan says
item.description: The U.S. government's efforts to manage pressure in the Treasury market risk merely shifting the problem down the road, according to JPMorgan's James Sullivan.

item.title: No more doom scrolling or Instagram Stories? A Meta trial loss could end the social media we know
item.description: "These trials are often compared to the Big Tobacco lawsuits of the 90s, and the outcome will likely be analogous as well," one analyst told CNBC.

item.title: New York unseats San Francisco as the top market for tech talent, CBRE reports
item.description: AI-related roles now account for nearly one-third of all tech-talent job listings in the U.S., per the new CBRE report.

item.title: Warsh faces Fed independence test as Bessent moves in on central bank's turf
item.description: Bessent’s effort to tamp down long-term Treasury yields could force Warsh to clarify how far the Fed should go in coordinating on bonds and the balance sheet.

item.title: Micron CEO: AI has 'totally changed' the equation for the boom-and-bust memory industry
item.description: Micron CEO Sanjay Mehrotra said on Thursday that AI has dramatically changed the memory business.

item.title: Debt consolidation loan vs. balance transfer credit card: Which is better?
item.description: Either one can help you tackle debt, but the best option depends on how much you owe, how quickly you can repay it and the fees involved.

item.title: Bessent says there's a 'very good chance' U.S. budget deficit under Trump has peaked
item.description: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said Thursday that there's a "very good chance" of the U.S. has seen its budget deficit peak under President Donald Trump.

item.title: Education Department recalculates student loan forgiveness counts, setting some PSLF borrowers back
item.description: Many borrowers pursuing Public Service Loan Forgiveness have recently learned that they're further away from debt cancellation than they'd expected.

item.title: Samsung plans up to $80 billion in shareholder returns after SK Hynix buyback
item.description: Samsung Electronics plans shareholder returns totaling 90 trillion won to 110 trillion won, including about 30 trillion won in third-quarter cash dividends.

item.title: Hyundai considering U.S. production increase at new Georgia plant, CEO tells CNBC
item.description: The potential capacity increase would be part of Hyundai's plan to invest $26 billion in the U.S. through 2028, Hyundai CEO José Muñoz told CNBC.

item.title: AI data center outrage is showing up everywhere from ads to elections
item.description: With less than three months until the midterm elections, opposition to AI data centers is becoming a bipartisan rallying cry in a growing number of states.

item.title: California AG tells CNBC that settling Paramount-WBD lawsuit would require 'robust structural remedies'
item.description: California AG Rob Bonta discussed the states' antitrust case to block the Paramount Skydance-Warner Bros. Discovery merger with CNBC's David Faber.

item.title: CFTC’s Innovation Advisory Committee meeting addresses emerging prediction market risks
item.description: The CFTC's first Innovation Advisory Committee meeting discussed risks of mention markets, with members advocating for tighter consumer protection.

item.title: Bessent says U.S. likely won't restart large-scale Iran combat as it steps up economic pressure
